purpose: Report repair-step compute/VRAM change on exactly the same physical GPU, independently of D3 seed-to-hardware scheduling
selection: Use predeclared D3-selected multi-task group seed0 and completed A0 seed0 checkpoints; no checkpoint selection by benchmark outcome
inputs: Common frozen TRAIN10k seed0 epoch0 first sampler batch and largest padded sampler batch; identical tensors for both models
optimization: Temporary model copies; AdamW with lr=0 solely to execute step kernels. Verify model parameters and buffers bitwise unchanged. No official training exposure or checkpoint updated.
timing: CUDA-synchronized forward+loss+backward+clip+AdamW compute only; excludes data loading/transfer. Full-epoch cost still uses actual D3 rate including loader, validation, checkpoint, startup overhead.
output: Per batch, per crossover block, GPU model/UUID, peak allocated/reserved VRAM, actual foreign-GPU observations, aggregate selected/A0 throughput and VRAM deltas
